Aragonese

edit

Etymology

edit

From Vulgar Latin *corāceōnem, derived from Latin cor.

Pronunciation

edit
  • IPA(key): /koɾaˈθon/
  • IPA(key): /koɾaˈson/ (Benasquese)
  • Rhymes: -on
  • Syllabification: co‧ra‧zón

Noun

edit

corazón m (plural corazons)

  1. (anatomy) heart

Galician

edit
Galician Wikipedia has an article on:
corazón
Wikipedia gl

Alternative forms

edit
  • coraçom, coração (reintegrationist)

Etymology

edit

From Old Galician-Portuguese coraçon, from Vulgar Latin *corāceōnem, derived from Latin cor.

Pronunciation

edit
 
  • IPA(key): /koɾaˈθoŋ/ [ko.ɾaˈθoŋ]
  • IPA(key): (standard) /koɾaˈθoŋ/ [ko.ɾaˈθoŋ]
  • IPA(key): (seseo) /koɾaˈsoŋ/ [ko.ɾaˈsoŋ]

  • Rhymes: -oŋ
  • Hyphenation: co‧ra‧zón

Noun

edit

corazón m (plural corazóns)

  1. heart (organ of the body)
  2. the seat of human love and kindness
  3. the seat of human fortitude, valor, spirit
  4. the center of an object; kernel
    Synonym: cerne
  5. (card games) heart (a playing card of the suit hearts, corazóns)

Spanish corazón

    Inherited from Old Spanish coraçon, from Vulgar Latin *corāceōnem, derived from Latin cor.

    Pronunciation

    edit
    • IPA(key): /koɾaˈθon/ [ko.ɾaˈθõn] (Spain, Equatorial Guinea)
    • IPA(key): /koɾaˈson/ [ko.ɾaˈsõn] (Latin America, Philippines)
    • Audio (Spain):(file)
    • Rhymes: -on
    • Syllabification: co‧ra‧zón

    Noun

    edit

    corazón m (plural corazones)

    1. (anatomy) heart (organ of the body)
    2. heart, emotions, kindness, spirit
      Synonyms: alma, pecho
      • 1999, Marc Anthony, Cory Rooney, “Dímelo”, in Marc Anthony‎[2], performed by Marc Anthony:
        No me dejes solo con mi corazón
        que está enloquecido con esta pasión
        Si es que me deseas, nena, dímelo
        porque por tu amor estoy muriendo yo
        Ay dímelo, ven dímelo
        porque por tu amor estoy muriendo yo
        Ay dímelo, ven dímelo
        porque por tu amor estoy muriendo yo
        Don’t leave me alone with my heart driven crazy with this passion
        If it’s true that you want me, baby, tell me, because I am dying for your love
        Oh, tell me, come on and tell me, because I am dying for your love
        Oh, tell me, come on and tell me, because I am dying for your love
    3. the center of an object
      1. core (of a fruit)
      2. artichoke heart
    4. (card games) heart (a playing card of the suit hearts, corazones)
